title: Move Dynamics GP database to Azure Data Lake

facts.text: Can create copy of Dynamics GP database in Azure Data Lake for future reference after migration.
Azure Data Lake Gen2 storage account with access to storage account name and key.
Open Cloud Migration Management page and select Azure Data Lake action.
Complete Azure Data Lake Migration Setup guided wizard.
Database folder in Azure Data Lake is always named gp-database; can rename after migration.
Subfolders follow Dynamics GP series folder naming conventions; unmapped files go to 3rd Party folder.
Must delete gp-database folder and contents before running wizard again.
